Making a mill
Three of your cows in a straight line along a drawn line is a mill. Every time you complete a mill you shoot (remove) one of your opponent\'s cows. You have two cows on the top row already.
Complete a mill, then shoot one of Light\'s cows.
Look along the top edge of the board.
Place a cow on the top-right corner, then tap any light cow.
That is a mill: three in a line, and Light is one cow down. Watch for your opponent\'s two-in-a-rows too, and block them.
Trapping vs shooting

Shooting is not the only way to win. If your opponent cannot move any cow on their turn, they are locked in (go tswala) and lose at once. Light\'s four cows in the top-left corner have just one free point left.
Win in one move by leaving Light with no legal move.
Find the one empty point next to a light cow.
It sits on the diagonal from the top-left corner. Step onto it with the cow from the inner square.
Locked in! No shot needed. Against a crowded board, trapping can be faster than shooting.
Escaping a lock
Now you are the one being squeezed. Light\'s cows surround yours, and most moves let Light shut the last door. A mill lets you shoot a cow out of the wall.
Keep at least one legal move through Light\'s next two turns.
Do not just shuffle: form a mill so you can shoot a blocker.
Look at the middle line coming down from the top edge. After the mill any shot will do; the cow on the right edge frees you the most.
You broke out. When you are short of moves, a mill that opens space is worth more than any other cow.
Flying tactics
With only three cows left you may fly (go fofa): move a cow to any empty point. Light is flying too and threatens to complete a line on the right side next turn.
Win this turn: Light also has three cows, so one shot is enough.
Blocking Light is fine, but striking first is better.
Your two cows on the bottom row need a third: fly to the bottom-right corner.
When both sides fly, the first mill usually decides. Always check for a winning flight before you defend.
Khutlotharo
Khutlotharo is the triangle game: three cows each, and the first line of three wins outright. A cow may also jump over a neighbouring cow to the empty point straight beyond it.
Win now. Light also threatens the top point.
The empty point at the top completes your centre line.
Your bottom-left cow can jump over the light cow above it to reach the top.
A jump wins it. In Khutlotharo, always count jumps as well as steps, for both sides.
How to play
New to Morabaraba? Read the rules in a minute.
Show me
Not now
Got it
Next
1 · Go baya: place
Each player has 12 cows. Take turns placing them on any empty point, Dark first.
2 · Make a mill, shoot
Three of your cows in a straight line is a mill. Each new mill lets you shoot one opposing cow. Cows in a mill are safe while the opponent has others to shoot.
3 · Go sutisa: move
When all cows are placed, move one cow per turn along a line to a neighbouring empty point. Break a mill and remake it to shoot again.
4 · Go fofa: fly
Down to three cows? Your cows may fly to any empty point.
5 · Winning
You win when your opponent has only two cows left or cannot move on their turn. Try the Academy for guided puzzles.
